summary: All 4 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised: frontend env/build contract and Atlas-safe startup seeding covered by new backend tests (static inspection + live idempotent-run checks), admin/stats bounding covered by a new backend test hitting the running server, and the core dashboard regression covered by a new browser check. Full backend suite (15 tests) and the new browser check pass; frontend production build completes cleanly.

checks.name: manual: yarn build
checks.evidence: cd /app/frontend && yarn build -> 'tsc -b && vite build' completed: 'built in 1.71s', dist/ emitted, no missing-env failure (only a non-blocking chunk-size warning).

checks.name: test_seed_source_has_no_bulk_delete_or_drop (test_tscheck_atlas_safe_seeding.py)
checks.evidence: backend/seed.py source contains no 'delete_many', 'drop_collection', or '.drop(' calls; grep across backend/*.py confirms the only delete_many usages are scoped session/user-specific operations in auth.py, engine.py, admin.py (not startup).

checks.name: test_seed_run_preserves_legacy_trade_wallet_session_records (test_tscheck_atlas_safe_seeding.py)
checks.evidence: Inserted tscheck-seed-* trade/wallet/session fixture rows, called seed.run() against the live local Mongo, then confirmed all three rows still exist and the admin user (admin@infinitenxt.com, role=admin) is present; fixtures deleted in finally.

checks.criterion: Admin stats query remains functional after bounding
checks.name: test_admin_stats_returns_bounded_fields (test_tscheck_admin_stats_bounded.py)
checks.evidence: POST /auth/login (admin) -> 200; GET /admin/stats -> 200 with int fields users_total, subscribers, payments, plans, invites_pending all present.

checks.criterion: Admin stats query remains functional after bounding
checks.name: test_admin_stats_requires_auth (test_tscheck_admin_stats_bounded.py)
admin-dashboard-core-regression
checks.evidence: Signed in at /login with admin@infinitenxt.com/Harsh@10576, landed on dashboard: presence-indicator, live-price-ticker (numeric text), feed-live-source, ticker-symbol (contains 'BTC'), and signal-panel all visible; no >=400 responses observed on any /api/* call during the flow.

notes: 8 total artifacts across 4 criteria (2 pure-API/static criteria got backend-only coverage; 1 API criterion got backend coverage; 1 UI criterion got a browser check). Fewer than 8 acceptance-matrix criteria overall, so no count-exceeded note needed.

seed.py inspection: admin/plan/site-settings seeding and index creation are all guarded by find_one-not-exists checks; the only delete_many calls in the codebase are scoped, request-triggered operations (session invalidation on logout/password-change, per-user wallet/trade reset), never part of the startup seed path.
admin/stats already bounded via to_list(10_000) / to_list(2000) caps in routers/admin.py; confirmed still returns 200 with the full expected shape.

Pre-existing regression test files (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py, test_tscheck_engine_never_sleeps.py, test_tscheck_trading_routes_require_auth.py) re-ran clean alongside the new tests - 15/15 backend tests passing.
Removed the stray .backup file left by the browser-check selector-fix iteration before finishing, per fixture/artifact hygiene.
